reason: When the permission cache denies, Check falls through to the database (service.go, patch lines 114-128). But Check first returns a denial from permDenialCache (patch lines 107-112), and every database denial is stored there (lines 137-139) with shortCacheTTL = 30s (service.go:32). So a permission granted after a denial stays blocked for up to 30s. Before the patch, a stale permCache entry caused a similar 30s delay, so the window is bounded and no longer than before.
